stem.text: Which statement about the properties of water is correct?

A.text: Bonds between hydrogen atoms cause water to have a high specific heat capacity.

B.text: The high latent heat of vaporisation of water is due to the presence of hydrogen bonds.

C.text: The high specific heat capacity of water causes cooling during evaporation.

D.text: Water can dissolve amylopectin as it has hydrophilic side chains.
